sentence: A normal compass won’t work on the Grand Line due to each island generating its own magnetic field.

title: Grand Line
sentence: In order to navigate the Grand Line, one needs a special type of compass known as a Log Pose.

title: Grand Line
sentence: The Log Pose works by locking on to the magnetism produced by one island and pointing toward that island.

title: Grand Line
sentence: After reaching said island and staying there for a certain amount of time, the Log Pose will reset and start locking on to the magnetism of the next island.

title: Grand Line
sentence: The time it takes for a Log Pose to set is different on each island; it may take a few hours, it may take a few days, or it may even take a full year.

title: Grand Line
sentence: A Log Pose for the first half of the Grand Line has only a single needle.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Alternatively, a Log Pose for the second half has three needles.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Each of the three needles locks on to the magnetic waves of one of three different islands.

title: Grand Line
sentence: This is because islands in the New World tend to experience changes in their magnetism.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Therefore, if you lose the magnetism of one island, you still have two backup options.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Furthermore, changes in magnetism can be caused by abnormalities on the island, the unstable magnetism of the island resulting in the corresponding needle jiggling.

title: Grand Line
sentence: The trick is to follow the needle that is most stable.

title: Grand Line
sentence: There is another type of Log Pose known as an Eternal Pose.

title: Grand Line
sentence: This version of the Log Pose is permanently locked onto the magnetism of a specific island and never resets.

title: Grand Line
sentence: This makes it easier for a crew to get to a specific island, rather than following a regular Log Pose through a trail of islands.

title: Grand Line
sentence: While it is possible to reach a specific island without an Eternal Pose, it can take many months, even when near the island in question.

title: Grand Line
sentence: At Reverse Mountain, the entrance of the Grand Line, there are a total of seven different islands that a Log Pose can lock on to.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Each is the beginning of a different route that one can travel across through the first half of the Grand Line, before eventually converging on the opposite side of the Red Line, at the entrance to the New World.

title: Grand Line
sentence: From there, the routes separate again, with each island pointing to three islands ahead of it.

title: Grand Line
sentence: Eventually, all the routes converge again at Lodestar Island, the last island accessible through conventional means.
